license_required.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice dietetics in the State.

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Dietetic Practice.

type.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Dietetic Practice.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Maryland Department of Health.

age_minimum.quote: The applicant must be at least 18 years old.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant must be of good moral character.

degree_required.value: baccalaureate degree (minimum); or master's/doctoral degree in nutritional sciences or related field
degree_required.quote: Have received at a minimum a baccalaureate degree from a college or university accredited by an educational accrediting association as required by the Commission on Dietetic Registration

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dietetic Registration; Council on Higher Education and Accreditation
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by an educational accrediting association as required by the Commission on Dietetic Registration; or ... accredited by an educational accrediting association recognized by the Council on Higher Education and Accreditation

required.quote: Have satisfactorily completed a program of supervised clinical experience approved by the Board

kind.quote: Have satisfactorily completed a program of supervised clinical experience approved by the Board

exams.name: Board-approved examination
exams.notes: Passing score determined by the Board; waiver available for those licensed in another state, registered by CDR, or certified by BCNS
exams.quote: the applicant must pass an examination approved by the Board under this subtitle.

interval_years.quote: Before the license expires, the licensee may renew it for an additional 2-year term

required.quote: the Board shall establish continuing education requirements as a condition to the renewal of licenses under this section.

available.quote: the Board may waive an examination requirement of this title for an individual who: (1) Is licensed to practice dietetics in another state or country

requirements.value: Applicant must pay application fee and provide adequate evidence of meeting qualifications and passing a comparable examination, or registration with CDR, or certification by BCNS
requirements.quote: Became licensed in the other state or country after passing, in that state or country, an examination that the Board determines to be comparable to the examination for which the applicant is seeking the waiver

exists.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Dietetic Practice.

national_certification.value: Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists (BCNS); Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR)
national_certification.quote: Submit to the Board proof of certification by the Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists; or Submit to the Board proof of registration as a dietitian with the Commission on Dietetic Registration of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics.

national_association.value: Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics; American Nutrition Association
national_association.quote: "Registered dietitian" means an individual registered with the Commission on Dietetic Registration, the accrediting body of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics.

scope_protection.quote: a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice dietetics in the State unless licensed by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively obtaining or attempting to obtain a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively obtains or attempts to obtain a license for the applicant or licensee or for another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively using a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively uses a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the title or regulations adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violates any provision of this title or any regulations adopted under this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing or discriminating against an individual in the provision of professional services because the individual is HIV positive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refuses, withholds from, denies, or discriminates against an individual with regard to the provision of professional service for which the licensee is licensed and qualified to render because the individual is HIV positive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of dietetics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commits fraud or deceit in the practice of dietetics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or nolo contendere plea to a felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is convicted of or pleads nolo contendere to a felony or to a crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a fee through fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtains or attempts to obtain a fee through fraud or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing a person to practice dietetics whose license has been suspended
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employs any person to practice dietetics whose license or certificate to practice a health occupation under this article has been suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or promoting misleading, deceiving, or untruthful advertising or promotional material
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Uses or promotes or causes the use of any misleading, deceiving, or untruthful advertising matter, or promotional literature, testimonial, guarantee, warranty, label, brand, insignia, or other representation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing unprofessional conduct or violating the Board's code of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commits any act of unprofessional conduct, as defined by the rules and regulations of the Board, or violates the code of ethics adopted by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing professional services while under the influence of alcohol or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Provides professional services while: (i) Under the influence of alcohol; or (ii) Using any narcotic or controlled dangerous substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by another state/country or convicted for an act that would be grounds for discipline in Maryland
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is disciplined by a licensing or disciplinary authority of any other state or country or convicted or disciplined by a court of any other state or country for an act that would be grounds for disciplinary action under this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing with an unauthorized person or supervising or aiding an unauthorized person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices dietetics with an unauthorized person or supervises or aids an unauthorized person in the practice of dietetics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to file or record required reports, or obstructing such filing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to file or record any report or record as required by law in the practice of dietetics, impedes or obstructs the filing or recording of the report or record, or induces another to fail to file or record the report or record

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting a false statement to collect a fee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submits a false statement to collect a fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being professionally, physically, or mentally incompetent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is professionally, physically, or mentally incompetent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promoting the sale of devices, appliances, or goods to a patient to exploit the patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotes the sale of devices, appliances, or goods to a patient so as to exploit the patient for financial gain

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to cooperate with a lawful investigation by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the Board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice dietetics" means to apply the principles derived from integrating knowledge of food, biochemistry, physiology, management science, behavioral science, and social science to human nutrition.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice dietetics" means to apply the principles derived from integrating knowledge of food, biochemistry, physiology, management science, behavioral science, and social science to human nutrition.

value: Assessing individual and community food practices and nutritional status using anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, dietary, and demographic data
Developing, establishing, and evaluating nutritional care plans
Nutrition counseling and education as a part of preventive or restorative health care
Determining, applying, and evaluating standards for food and nutrition services
Applying scientific research to the role of food in the maintenance of health and the treatment of disease
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice dietetics" includes: (i) Assessing individual and community food practices and nutritional status using anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, dietary, and demographic data ... (ii) Developing, establishing, and evaluating nutritional care plans ... (iii) Nutrition counseling and education ... (iv) Determining, applying, and evaluating standards for food and nutrition services; and (v) Applying scientific research to the role of food in the maintenance of health and the treatment of disease.

direct_supervision_defined.quote: "Supervision" means the management of an individual who aids in the practice of dietetics by a licensed dietitian-nutritionist who may or may not be on the premises.
